claims: Blue is located between violet and cyan.
Common shades of blue include navy, azure, sky, and cyan.
Blue is a dominant color in nature (sky/sea) due to Rayleigh scattering.
Many social media websites use blue logos.
Light/bright shades of blue include azure, sky blue, cyan, baby blue, cerulean.
Dark/subtle shades of blue include navy blue, indigo, midnight blue, sea foam.
Prussian blue is a deep, traditional blue pigment.
Cobalt blue is known for its intense, vivid tone.
Ultramarine was historically made from lapis lazuli.
The idiom "feeling blue" means feeling sad or depressed.
The idiom "out of the blue" means something unexpected.
"Blue ribbon" represents top quality or first place.
"Blue" is a British boy band formed in 2000.
The boy band "Blue" is known for hits like "All Rise".
"Blue" is a graphical computer music environment written in Java.
